user.title: Battery Arsenal
user.description: Battery Arsenal builds a household battery inventory from the data Battery Notes already knows. Select Submit to add it.

abort.already_configured: Battery Arsenal is already set up.
abort.battery_notes_not_found: Battery Notes is required but is not loaded. Install it from HACS and set it up, then add Battery Arsenal again.

data.degraded_mode: Degraded mode (list battery devices Battery Notes does not track)

data_description.report_path: Relative paths are resolved inside the config directory.
data_description.non_consumable_keywords: Battery types matching any keyword are listed but not counted in totals.
data_description.restock_months: How many months of stock the suggested stock level should cover.

battery_notes_missing.title: Battery Notes is not available
battery_notes_missing.description: Battery Arsenal relies on Battery Notes, which is not currently loaded. Inventory sensors are unavailable until Battery Notes returns. Install and set up Battery Notes from HACS; this issue clears automatically once it loads.

battery_notes_contract_changed.title: Battery Notes data looks different
battery_notes_contract_changed.description: Battery Notes entities were found, but none expose a battery type attribute. The upstream data format may have changed. Check that Battery Notes is up to date and working; this issue clears automatically once battery types are readable again.

generate_report.name: Generate report
generate_report.description: Build a battery inventory report, write it to disk, and return it as response data.

format.name: Format
format.description: Which file(s) to write: markdown, csv, or both.

path.name: Output folder
path.description: Folder to write into. Relative paths resolve inside the config directory.

refresh.name: Refresh inventory
refresh.description: Force an immediate rebuild of the inventory.
